acceptanceCriteria: Each test is run at least 200 times under load (-count and -race where applicable) and the failure is either reproduced and fixed, or recorded as not reproduced with the run evidence
Any fix removes the timing dependency rather than widening a timeout
body: Suspected, not confirmed. TestPGOV0019ShadowCancelKillsTheGroupBeforeTheReap failed in batch-1021d CI and TestSTRV0060PathDigestRefusesSwap in batch-1021b CI; both passed on rerun with no change to their code. Each spurious failure costs a ~31-minute CI rerun.
title: Suspected flaky tests: TestPGOV0019ShadowCancelKillsTheGroupBeforeTheReap and TestSTRV0060PathDigestRefusesSwap failed once in batch CI and passed on rerun
